option_a_payload_carriers.owners: SealedSemanticProposalRunProducer -> SealedSourceNormalizationEvidenceProducer -> BootstrapV3GraphFreeInterpreter -> SourceNormalizationStage -> atomic V3 registry/reload
option_a_payload_carriers.carriers: BootstrapProposalRunPayloadV3 carries source-ordered duplicate-free transport_requests exactly equal to attempt-referenced request digests (shared retry requests allowed), canonical provenance tuple, attempts, and normalized proposals with originating_attempt_digest; every normalized proposal directly retains source-ordered mentions plus the closed fact|correction|retraction|action_state|identity operation union with typed entity/literal, predicate, evidence, action, and identity fields. The predicate and temporal lane arms are native BootstrapPredicateLanePayloadV3/BootstrapTemporalLanePayloadV3 candidate/result trees, each source/segment/provenance/manifest-bound and closed over exact span/quote, reference/value/ambiguity/status fields. Native temporal references retain source-field, authority-basis/provenance, source-context and bootstrap-provenance identity; candidate IDs cover complete value/reference/resolver identity; ambiguity sets retain complete canonical alternatives and value-basis keys and are non-promotable. The carriers never embed PredicateEventInventory, TemporalResolution, a generic candidate, SegmentLanguageRoute, or V2 wrapper. One attempt_closure preimage covers ordered request/attempt/proposal digests; atomic closure nests requests only in the proposal payload member
option_a_payload_carriers.recovery: reopen validates retained typed carrier bytes from the atomic generation with zero external read-back, re-fetch, ambient reconstruction, or V2 bridge
option_a_payload_carriers.limits: BootstrapV3PayloadLimitAuthority is a required derivation CTV leaf and exact equality authority through proposal/lane/request/manifest/result/atomic/recovery; its policy carries proposal attempts/proposals/four lane/aggregate byte and count quotas plus per-proposal mention, five operation-kind, action-role/participant, temporal-qualifier, identity predecessor/successor/reference-assignment, and evidence-item quotas; absent, foreign, duplicate, policy/member/digest/join substitutions reject before effects
option_a_payload_carriers.consumer: BootstrapV3GraphFreeInterpreter.interpret_and_align accepts only retained V3 proposal/four-lane carriers and exact policy/authority, reads predicate and temporal data only through the native V3 payloads, resolves each temporal attachment to one exact unambiguous candidate/value/reference/lane identity and forbids ambiguity-alternative promotion, expands each canonical operation member once into the fully typed V3 subject, observation, consensus, identity-partition, coverage, dependency, interpretation, and alignment subtree, and requires parser primary=stanza and corroborating=spacy with exact distinct retained lane-result digests and typed analyzer fingerprints before stable assignment. It returns typed noncommit on any missing, duplicate, foreign, cross-kind, cross-segment, non-bijective, lane-swapped, lane-fingerprint-substituted, temporal-reference-substituted, ambiguity-attached, or two-role/temporal-role join; it never constructs SemanticProposal, SegmentLanguageRoute, PredicateEventInventory, or TemporalResolution, calls a V2 decoder, reads back an external artifact, or looks up ambient route/policy state
option_a_payload_carriers.status: implemented; native BootstrapPredicateLanePayloadV3 and BootstrapTemporalLanePayloadV3 contracts, closed codecs, sealing conversion, quota checks, native-only interpreter reads, atomic V3 reload, and production coordinator reachability are implemented. The normal-fact memory/JSONL lost-ack vectors are the remaining revision-bound closure evidence.
